metroShare.note: Assumed metro modal split for stadium spectators based on parking limits and feeder buses.

gateBaseRate.note: Standard AFC turnstile throughput with paper QR and smart card mix.

gateStaffBonus.note: Throughput gain when customer care marshal assists passengers with QR scanner alignment.

maxStaffGateBonus.note: Diminishing returns threshold for additional marshals at gate line.

platformAreaM2.note: Effective clear passenger holding surface on Motera Island platform.

safeDensity.note: Level of Service D ceiling; free movement and platform edge clearances maintained.

meteringDensityTrigger.note: Level of Service E threshold triggering concourse gate hold to prevent platform crowd surge.

criticalDensity.note: Hazardous crush density (Level of Service F); risk of crowd surge and platform edge push.

trainCapacity.note: GMRC 3-car trainset nominal crush capacity (6 pax/m² standees).

freeShareOnArrival.note: Proportion of train capacity vacant when arriving at terminal/origin station.

stairEscalatorRate.note: Combined capacity of fixed stairwells and ascending/descending escalators.

concourseDwellSec.note: Mean passenger transit time from ticket check to stairwell foot.
